desc: Formalize the feasibility condition for a fixed common sum S, including how A's permutation interacts with B's fixed and -1 entries.
Derive candidate values for S: only pair sums a+b of fixed entries matter when a fixed-fixed match is required (needed > 0); else always feasible.
Implement the solution: needed = nA+nB-N, if needed<=0 print Yes, else accumulate C[v+u] += min(cntA[v],cntB[u]) for sums >= max(maxA,maxB) and print Yes as soon as some C[s] >= needed, else No.
Verify edge cases (all -1, needed<=0 trivial Yes, zero values, single distinct value, large values/no overflow in Python).
Confirm complexity: O(N + D_A*D_B) <= 4e6 pair operations, safe for N=2000.
Confirm the three provided samples all produce the expected outputs.
